offering_description.value: Provides a global distribution system and software for the travel industry. Connects airlines, hotels and other travel suppliers with travel agencies and corporate buyers, and sells airline IT software (reservations, retailing, operations) to carriers. Delivered as cloud-based platforms and transaction processing.

primary_products.value: global distribution system; airline reservation and passenger service software; airline retailing and merchandising software; airline operations software; hospitality software

primary_services.value: travel booking and distribution; airline IT hosting; software implementation and support; travel data and analytics

customer_segment.value: B2B: airlines, hotels, car rental and rail suppliers, travel agencies, online travel agencies, corporate travel buyers

end_markets.value: airlines; hospitality and lodging; travel agencies; corporate travel

revenue_model.value: transaction or usage fees: booking fees paid by travel suppliers per distributed reservation; subscription: recurring SaaS and hosted airline IT solutions fees; service fees: implementation, consulting and support for airline customers
revenue_model.category: transaction or usage fees; subscription; service fees

value_chain_position.value: software / platform: operates travel marketplace and airline IT platforms, sold to airlines, hotels and travel agencies

geography_served.value: global: Customers in North America, Europe, Asia-Pacific, Middle East, Africa and Latin America

specialization.value: related lines: travel distribution, airline IT and hospitality solutions

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: sales teams contracting with airlines, hotels and travel agencies; partners / resellers: travel agencies and online agencies that use the platform to sell supplier content

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: data privacy rules such as GDPR, payment security standards, and travel distribution and competition regulation
